SpatialPredicate.description:
Spatial predicates for filtering features by geographic relationship. Predicates are mutually exclusive — use exactly one per request. The parameter name is the spatial operation, the value is a GeoJSON geometry to test against.

| Predicate | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `around` | Within radius meters (requires `radius`) |
| `intersects` | Feature overlaps the input geometry |
| `within` | Feature is fully inside the input geometry |
| `contains` | Feature fully contains the input geometry |
| `crosses` | Feature crosses the input geometry |
| `touches` | Feature shares boundary but not interior |
| `not_intersects` | Feature does not overlap |
| `not_within` | Feature is not fully inside |
| `not_contains` | Feature does not fully contain |

not_contains.description: Geometry that features must NOT contain

not_intersects.description: Geometry that features must NOT intersect

not_within.description: Geometry that features must NOT be within

radius.description: Search radius in meters. Required for `around`, optional buffer for other predicates.

within.description: Geometry that features must be within

SpatialPredicate.title: SpatialPredicate

FeatureCollection.description:
GeoJSON FeatureCollection (RFC 7946). For paginated endpoints, metadata is returned in HTTP response headers rather than the body:

| Header | Description |
|---|---|
| `X-Limit` | Requested result limit |
| `X-Has-More` | `true` if more results exist |
| `X-Next-Cursor` | Opaque cursor for next page (cursor pagination) |
| `X-Next-Offset` | Numeric offset for next page (offset pagination) |
| `Link` | RFC 8288 `rel="next"` link to the next page |

Content-Type is `application/geo+json`.

city.description: City or town name. Present for address results.

street.description: Street name. Present for address and interpolated results.

info.description:
Geospatial data API serving the complete OpenStreetMap planet dataset.

Plaza provides geocoding, routing, search, isochrones, elevation, map matching,
route optimization, and raw OSM element queries — all from a single API. Spatial
data is indexed using a proprietary H3 hexagonal tiling system for fast lookups
at any scale.

**Authentication**: Pass your API key via `Authorization: Bearer <key>`, `x-api-key: <key>` header, or `api_key=<key>` query parameter.

**Response format**: Spatial endpoints return GeoJSON (`application/geo+json`). Paginated responses put metadata in HTTP headers (`X-Limit`, `X-Has-More`, `X-Next-Cursor`, `Link`), not the body.
